question: Will SpaceXAI rename itself to SpaceXSI (or another "SI" name) by end of 2026?
resolution_criteria:
Background: On Sep 29, 2026 Trump signed the executive order "Inaugurating the Era of

Super Intelligence", directing federal agencies to say "Super Intelligence"/"SI" instead

of "AI". On Oct 4, 2026, asked on X whether SpaceXAI could be renamed SpaceXSI, Elon Musk

replied "Yes, we will make that change." He gave no date. At market creation the official account is still @SpaceXAI.


Resolves YES if, before Dec 31, 2026 11:59 PM ET, EITHER of these happens:

1. X account: the official X account of SpaceX's AI unit (currently @SpaceXAI) changes

   its handle OR its display name to an SI name.

2. Website: the unit's official website (currently x.ai, or wherever it redirects) shows

   an SI name as the company name in its header logo or browser page title.


"SI name" = the unit's name with "AI" replaced by "SI", "Super Intelligence" or

"Superintelligence". Spacing, capitalization and punctuation don't matter.

Counts: SpaceXSI, SpaceX SI, SpaceX Super Intelligence, SpaceX Superintelligence.


Does NOT count:

- Statements of intent, including Musk's Oct 4 reply or any later "we will..." post

- Musk's personal account, employees' accounts, or third parties using the name

- News headlines saying it was "renamed" unless 1 or 2 has actually happened

  (some outlets already wrote "renames" about the Oct 4 announcement)

- Renaming only a product (e.g. Grok) rather than the unit itself

- A rename to anything without SI/Super Intelligence (e.g. plain "SpaceX") -> NO


A change that is later reverted still counts, as long as it is documented by a

Wayback Machine/archive.today snapshot or a news report saying the account or site

changed.

Resolves NO if neither 1 nor 2 has happened by the deadline.

# SpaceXAI to SpaceXSI rename: research as of 2026-10-09

## 1. Resolution source
- There are two sources: the official X account (currently @SpaceXAI, checking handle and display name) and the x.ai header logo or browser page title. I could not fetch either one directly.
- 2026-10-05: Reports after Musk's reply said the company had not yet changed its websites or social media accounts, and gave no date for the rebrand. [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/spacex-renaming-ai-unit-spacexsi-112228799.html), [Euronews](https://www.euronews.com/2026/10/05/musk-to-follow-trump-and-rebrand-spacexai-as-spacexsi)
- I found no source dated on or before 2026-10-09 showing the handle, display name or site already changed.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question yet. Musk's commitment is an informal X reply, not a corporate filing, so the name counts as proposed, not final. [Calcalist](https://www.calcalistech.com/ctechnews/article/plza12hnm), [Seeking Alpha](https://seekingalpha.com/news/4650066-spacexai-to-be-rebranded-as-spacexsi-elon-musk-says)
- Some outlets wrote headlines saying it was "renamed" anyway. The question explicitly does not count these. [Fox Business](https://www.foxbusiness.com/technology/elon-musk-rebrands-spacexai-following-trump-directive), [Tech Insider](https://tech-insider.org/musk-renames-spacexai-spacexsi-trump-order-2026/), [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/spacex-climbs-5-musk-renames-144603092.html)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- About 2026-10-05: SpaceX stock (SPCX) rose about 5% on the rename news, according to one Yahoo Finance markets article. [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/spacex-climbs-5-musk-renames-144603092.html)
- 2026-10-05: Musk also said "SpaceX is a super intelligence company." This would be the unit's second name change of 2026. [American Bazaar](https://americanbazaaronline.com/2026/10/05/musk-to-rename-spacexai-as-spacexsi-after-trumps-super-intelligence-push-489405/), [Not a Tesla App](https://www.notateslaapp.com/news/4770/musk-spacexai-will-be-renamed-spacexsi-dropping-ai)
- 2026-10-04: Asked on X about renaming the unit SpaceXSI, Musk replied "Yes, we will make that change." [Seeking Alpha](https://seekingalpha.com/news/4650066-spacexai-to-be-rebranded-as-spacexsi-elon-musk-says)
- 2026-09-29: Trump signed the "Inaugurating the Era of Super Intelligence" order. It covers federal agency language (shortened to "SI") and does not apply to private companies. It followed a White House meeting with tech leaders, including Musk. [ABC News 4 / TNND](https://abcnews4.com/news/nation-world/trumps-executive-order-replaces-artificial-intelligence-with-super-intelligence-china-industrial-revolution-industry-elon-musk-mark-zuckerberg-politics-president-donald-trump)

## 4. Base rates
- The closest precedent is the xAI to SpaceXAI rename:
  - 2026-02: SpaceX acquired xAI.
  - Early May 2026: Musk posted that xAI would be dissolved as an independent company.
  - 2026-07-06/07: @xai became @SpaceXAI, with a logo transition video.
  - The gap from stated intent to the handle change was about 2 months, and the handle changed before any corporate filings. [Gigazine](https://gigazine.net/gsc_news/en/20260707-xai-change-spacexai), [ProPakistani](https://propakistani.pk/2026/07/07/elon-musks-xai-officially-rebrands-as-spacexai/amp/), [Design Compass](https://designcompass.org/en/2026/07/08/xai-spacexai-new-logo/)
- Musk changes X handles quickly once he decides (Twitter to X in 2023, @xai to @SpaceXAI), but he also has a record of missing stated timelines. I found no systematic data on how often his "we will" posts about branding get carried out.
- The question window is about 12 weeks (Oct 9 to Dec 31). Unlike the earlier rename, this one needs no merger, so it is mostly a cosmetic change to the handle or display name.

## 5. Other forecasts
- 2026-10-09: I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market on a SpaceXSI rename. [search results](https://www.cbinsights.com/company/polymarket/alternatives-competitors)
- I found no expert forecasts either. One Investing.com analysis piece covers the rebrand's significance but makes no forecast about timing. [Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/analysis/spacexai-is-becoming-spacexsi--here-is-why-that-matters-more-than-it-looks-200688924)

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- An X handle or display-name change could happen at any time with no warning. The July precedent happened overnight.
- Related accounts could change in a coordinated way, for example Tesla's @Tesla_AI. Watch for this as a signal.
- Musk is likely to post more about "SI", and the administration may keep pushing the SI terminology.
- SPCX corporate events, such as Q3 earnings around late October (I have not confirmed the date) or filings, could bring a formal rebrand.
- One thing to watch: the legal entity name (SpaceXAI LLC) could stay the same even if the brand changes. That would not matter here, because the question only looks at the X account and the website header or title.
